hero.title: DARÉ
hero.subtitle: A sonic installation by Shumba Maasai

about.title: The Daré
paragraphs: Daré creates a space to encounter knowledge through sound, memory, heritage and presence, offering audiences a way to listen beyond information and reconnect with what can only be understood through experience.
statement: A gathering of memory, feeling and imagination.

artist.title: The Artist
artist.name: Shumba Maasai
artist.bio: Shumba Maasai is a Zimbabwean-born, London-based artist working across music, sound and performance. DARÉ is his first installation.
